about: Linear sRGB medians from the example photo (840 x 1120 webp, decoded with the sRGB curve). The photo itself is kept out of the repository and the page. Flash at dusk; the white cat reads 0.85, so readings are close to albedo times the flash irradiance.
observations: No cast shadows from the lace, channels or straps are visible on the skin: the flash is on the lens axis.
The lower belly, which turns away from the camera, reads darker through the mesh than the belly facing it (0.133 vs 0.188 in green).
The satin highlight is tinted (red:green:blue about 1 : 0.24 : 0.32 after removing the base colour), not white.

calibration.method: Scene irradiance pi (white albedo 1 renders 1.0). Fair-skin albedo iterated until the front-centre skin under the on-axis flash renders the photo's bare-skin reading; then the net's bar width and the yarn's translucency fitted to the photo's mesh-over-skin colour. Render values are scene-linear means at the same places (front centre, z = 0.355 m for skin, z = 0.09 m for mesh).

fits.note: first estimate from a plain alpha-blend reading of the photo: too dark

thin_film_on_metal.about: Blender Principled BSDF thin film, normal-incidence reflectance (linear RGB) of a smooth surface under white light.
